reviews.title: Simple product, large collection of voices
reviews.pros:
- Easy to learn and start getting voiceovers

- Simple pricing

- Multiple feature and not just text to speech
reviews.cons: - Nothing specific at the moment, enjoying creating voiceovers
reviews.overall: It's a great tool for anyone who wants to work on a budget and wishes to use multiple voices in a single narration.

reviews.title: Smartest tool for text to speech
reviews.pros:
1. Transcription is very effective.

2. AI voice change is just a very unique and much needed offering.

3. Audio-Video synchronisation  is just really good.
reviews.cons: None that I encountered so far, the tool is well built.
reviews.overall: Smart tool for anyone needing to convert their script to voice. Voices are good and platform features are excellent to come out with the right result.

reviews.title: Must for eLearning narrations
reviews.pros:
1. Voice options especially the Young adult ones.

2. Easy platform to use.

3. Really cheap compared to other text to speech tools.
reviews.cons: Can increase more voice option for Australian voices.
reviews.overall: Very smooth. Got to my desired output very quickly. I was able to deliver the quality training material to my clients.

reviews.title: Quite exciting!
reviews.pros: Cheapest thing I have got for getting human sounding voiceovers otherwise its just expensive to get these things done. The AI changer is a great product to have, especially since it ensures that the timing remains intact, I could just change my video voiceover to multiple languages and not have to spend time on syncing them with the video screen.
reviews.cons: Just a feature request - Add screen recording to the option would be much easy to get everything done with murf itself.
reviews.overall: Amazing tool. If you have a voiceover requirement do try Murf text to speech.  Its offer very unique features which are very helpful for getting voiceovers done.

reviews.title: High quality and value for money
reviews.pros: Great AI voices, sounds almost human. Sync option with videos. Some of the Pro voices are just amazing.
reviews.cons: None. Served me my purpose of course narrations at fraction of a cost.
reviews.overall: Best text to speech software out there. A much recommended. I would give 5 star just for the voices.

reviews.title: Best text to speech with great features
reviews.pros:
Ability to convert text to human voices that can be used as a perfect alternate to the professional narration. Saved me a lot of cost on hiring voiceover actors. 

The option of voices are also good across accents.
reviews.cons: Nothing really. Have upgraded to their yearly plans and I am a very satisfied customer.
reviews.overall: Murf is a great online software to convert text to voices. I think the advancement in technology is path-breaking that can help ease out the requirement of professional narration for your projects. Much recommended.

reviews.title: Amazing voiceover generation tool
reviews.pros: Many - Value for money, Voice sound very human, easy to use tool, best collection on AI voices, very prompt customer support.
reviews.cons: Cant find any till now. Much simple tool, highly recommended.
reviews.overall: Have been working with this tool for more than 6 months now, and I must say its one of best software I have come across. The tool is simple, and loaded with features to get the final voiceover output for your projects. I no longer need to hire expensive voice actors and then sync their audio with videos on another third part tool.
